author: PDQ
quote:
As someone who has played Silent Hill 2 consistently over the years since it released, this game has made me a very happy fan.

Very faithful to the original, unlike the Resident Evil remakes that suffer from cut content. This is about as good as it gets in terms of a remake.

Hopefully we can begin look forward to Harry and Heather's stories soon.
